up: Retrieve the ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target TYK2 (CHEMBL3553). Filter on assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Do not apply any additional filters on assay type, confidence score, document type, or DOI. Return each qualifying compound exactly once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ac.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3553' AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
